speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific characteristics of your longstanding rash, such as its color, texture, and any scaling or blisters you might see. Additionally, can you pinpoint exactly where you feel the numbness and tingling on your palms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Given your occupation working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, have you noticed any specific seasonal changes to your rash or any exposure to plants like poison ivy, or insects such as mites or ticks? Also, do you have any known allergies or previous diagnoses of autoimmune conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)

The combination of a pruritic rash, peripheral neuropathy (numbness/tingling in palms), and loss of eyebrows and eyelashes is highly characteristic of leprosy. The hypopigmented macules further support this. Are you experiencing any weakness in your hands or feet, or have you noticed any deformities?
